setting: A small valley between hills and the sea, with streams, woods and grassland. One family lives here alone: the old, the grown, the young and a baby. Berries grow in the grass by the woods, fish swim in the streams, deer graze the meadows and a few wolves live in the woods. Seasons turn quickly; in winter nothing grows and nights are colder. People live about seventy years here, but the years pass fast.

bands.name: the family
bands.history: We have always lived in this valley, one family, three generations. We know how to make fire and build shelters; our shelter and fire stand at our camp. Our family has always grown: children are our joy and our future. There are two couples among us: the parents of our children, and a young couple who hope for children of their own.
